statistics.unit: packet; one run per arm in Stage 1
statistics.harm: h = score_A - score_B in [-1, 1], steps of 1/4

paired_net_test.p_rule: p_NI = (1 + count(bootstrap_distribution >= δ)) / (99999 + 1); NI when p_NI < α′

exact_fallback.when: fewer than 20 packets with h != 0, or a zero-width or nonfinite bootstrap interval
exact_fallback.bound: U(a) = binomtest(h+, n, less).proportion_ci(1 - a/2, exact).high - 0.25 * binomtest(h-, n, greater).proportion_ci(1 - a/2, exact).low
exact_fallback.validity: 0 < h <= 1 when h > 0 and h <= -1/4 when h < 0, so E[h] <= P(h > 0) - 1/4 P(h < 0); Bonferroni covers both bounds; with binary scores the step is 1 and this is #431's rule
exact_fallback.p_rule: p = inf{a in (0,1): U(a) < δ} by bisection; p = 1 when none; NI when p < α

statistics.switch_step: the exact branch is more conservative, so one more discordant packet can move a data set from not NI (exact) to NI (bootstrap); inherited from #431 and included in the simulated rates

earlier_guard_rejected.reason: harmful-only exact test: very low power and an inversion at the switch

calibration.rule: the first α′ in the grid whose worst false-NI rate at E[h] = δ has an upper 95% Clopper-Pearson bound at or below the calibration bound, at the selected n
calibration.deviation_from_431: #431 leaves the gate open when calibration fails; here α′ is fixed before any data so the criterion stays decidable

multiplicity.F1_and_F2: statsmodels multipletests([p1, p2], alpha=0.05, method='holm'); missing hypothesis p = 1

statistics.diagnostic_only: scipy.stats.permutation_test; nonsignificant equality is not non-inferiority

sizing.rule: simulate the full rule; n = smallest grid value with P(NI | identical arms) >= target under every required law and the pilot law; calibrate α′ at that n with the calibration replicates; if α′ lowers power below target take the next n; n above n_max or no α′: the unpowered row
sizing.never_shrinks: a pilot with few differences does not lower n: the exact branch governs there

planning_results.source: appendix A, gate_b_sizing.py, seed 20260929, 1,000 replicates per power cell, 4,000 per calibration null law, 2,000 bootstrap resamples per replicate
planning_results.reading: At the earlier draft's n = 155 the stated 80% power held only near 20% discordance; the low-discordance regime (5-10% of packets differ) gave 0.26 and 0.15. The earlier floor n = 40 can never return NI at δ = 0.05.
